description: This file is a Next.js configuration module written in JavaScript (with ESM syntax) defining project-specific settings such as webpack customizations, URL rewrites, headers, and experimental features.

methods.name: webpack
methods.description: Customizes the Webpack configuration used during development to set up WebSocket URL for Hot Module Replacement (HMR) based on environment variables.

methods.name: rewrites
methods.description: Defines URL rewrite rules for proxying API calls and static assets to backend services, considering environment variable fallbacks for backend URLs.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers for security hardening, such as X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy, for all routes.
